events.title: Redlands Coast AdventureFest
events.location: Redlands Coast (various locations, ~45 min from Brisbane CBD)
events.description: A free, community-led outdoor adventure festival in its second year featuring 100+ activities including adrenaline sports, hands-on workshops, kids' activities, interactive displays and nature experiences. Run by Ranger Stacey, this is a genuinely nature-focused event attracting adventurous, outdoorsy people.

events.title: SLQ: Underwater Soundscape Composition Workshop
events.location: State Library of Queensland (The Edge), South Brisbane
events.description: Hands-on workshop led by sound artist and researcher Dr Leah Barclay exploring underwater listening and soundscape composition. Participants discover the art and science of listening to hidden aquatic ecosystems and create original soundscape compositions — a rare intersection of art, science, and environmental thinking.

events.title: GOMA Friday Nights — Olafur Eliasson: Presence
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Extended gallery hours with multi-sensory art by Olafur Eliasson, vinyl listening bar with Brisbane DJs, live performances, and drinks/food. A social, creative evening merging art, music and connection in an intimate cultural setting.

events.title: QSO Italian Gala
events.description: Queensland Symphony Orchestra under Maestro Umberto Clerici performs Italian masterworks including Rossini's Barber of Seville, Vivaldi's Triple Concerto for violin, cello and accordion, and dramatic works by Puccini and Verdi. Features world-renowned accordionist James Crabb.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Jiggle Jiggle (Josh Thomas)
events.description: Headline act from Josh Thomas at Brisbane Comedy Festival 2026. Described as quirky, hilarious and authentic, featuring his new show Jiggle Jiggle. Part of the festival's diverse 300+ event program across four iconic venues.

events.title: QSO Maestro Series: Rachmaninov & Shostakovich (Main Night)
events.description: Main performance of QSO's Maestro Series featuring Rachmaninov's beloved Piano Concerto No. 2 alongside Shostakovich's emotional 5th Symphony and contemporary work by Cathy Milliken. Intimate classical concert attracting thoughtful music lovers.

events.title: Olafur Eliasson: Presence — Exhibition
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Exclusive Brisbane exhibition of major works by contemporary artist Olafur Eliasson. Immersive, multi-sensory experience exploring light, colour, perception and environmental themes through large-scale installations and a meticulously constructed riverbed.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Okay, I Believe You (Auslan Comedy)
events.description: Auslan-interpreted comedy show — a rare opportunity for accessible, inclusive stand-up comedy in Brisbane. Strong community atmosphere at an atmospheric independent venue.

events.title: Australian Cinémathèque: Double Take (Film Program)
events.location: Australian Cinémathèque, Gallery of Modern Art, South Brisbane
events.description: Curated international and art house film program at GOMA's dedicated cinema space. Rare opportunity for thoughtful, intellectually engaging film culture in Brisbane during this period.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — City Walking Tours
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Regular guided walking tours exploring Brisbane's CBD history, architecture and hidden stories. Recurring community event attracting curious, conversation-loving participants. Bookings essential.

events.title: QSO Maestro Series Preview Concerts
events.description: Two preview performances of the Maestro Series featuring Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto No. 2, Shostakovich's 5th Symphony, and contemporary work by Cathy Milliken. Chance to experience the program before the main Saturday performance.

events.title: GOMA Kids Tour: Presence & Play
events.location: Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
events.description: Multi-sensory family tour of Olafur Eliasson: Presence designed for children. Guided through playful art experiences that spark imagination and build connection, plus exclusive exhibition viewing in a crowd-free setting before public opening.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Shad & Pete Save the World!
events.description: Late-night raw variety comedy show running throughout the festival. Intimate, irreverent, unpredictable format suited to those seeking experimental comedy in an atmospheric independent venue.

events.title: SLQ: Dearly Departed: Death in Life — Exhibition
events.location: State Library of Queensland (SLQ), South Brisbane
events.description: Thought-provoking exhibition engaging with death, dying, memory and remembrance through tarot symbolism and visual storytelling. Includes hands-on workshop inviting participants to create symbolic artworks using tarot archetypes.

events.title: Queensland Museum Lunchtime Lectures
events.datetime: Thursdays at lunchtime (check for May dates; next confirmed: 28 May)
events.description: Recurring lunchtime lecture series where Queensland Museum staff present research and behind-the-scenes work. Topics include restoration projects and collections history. Casual, community-oriented format ideal for curious lunch-breakers.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — Permanent & Current Exhibitions
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Permanent and rotating exhibitions exploring Brisbane's history, culture and identity. Rooftop location in City Hall provides beautiful setting. Recurring walking tours also available Wednesdays and Saturdays.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival: Bron Lewis
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse – Underground Theatre, New Farm
events.description: Stand-up comedy show by Bron Lewis, a Brisbane-based performer exploring the chaos of motherhood, three kids, and a new puppy. Intimate show in the Underground Theatre, one of Brisbane's most atmospheric comedy venues.

events.title: Museum of Brisbane — Select Sundays Walking Tours
events.datetime: Sun 17 May (check website to confirm; recurring select Sundays)
events.location: Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
events.description: Recurring Sunday walking tours departing from Museum of Brisbane exploring Brisbane's streets, architecture and history. Community-oriented, conversation-focused experience attracting curious locals and visitors.
